name: Doubao App Avatar
author: wynn
variant_note: An AI-generated app-icon-style circular portrait edition by wynn, distinct from the same author's ivory-cardigan waist-up pet. It retains a short neck, black shirt with white collar and pale-blue circular avatar fill, with facial acting, head turns, nine state animations and sixteen v2 gaze directions. The circular fill stays anchored during gaze motion and the surrounding canvas is transparent.
source_notes: AI-generated avatar adaptation and animation based on Doubao's official app icon and the user's app-icon screenshot. description: A friendly Doubao app-style circular portrait with a short neck, black shirt and white collar. Its pale-blue circle is part of the avatar; outside it is transparent. Facial expressions, nods and head turns provide nine animations and sixteen v2 look directions.
